de: 1976 Olympic weightlifting champion David Riegert died on October 26 at the age of 79. The death of the famous Soviet athlete and honored coach of Russia was reported in the Weightlifting Federation of Russia (FTAR).

de: In Kiev, explosions thundered amid reports of a missile attack and the approach of drones. Ukrainian media and monitoring channels have reported possible attacks on the city’s energy infrastructure.

t: Украина ограничила бронь от мобилизации на предприятиях ВПК и энергетики
d: Правительство Украины установило квоту на бронирование военнообязанных сотрудников предприятий оборонно-промышленного и топливно-энергетического комплексов на уровне 95%. Решение приняли 23 октября, сообщается на сайте кабмина.
te: Ukraine has limited the armor from mobilization at the enterprises of the military-industrial complex and energy
de: The government of Ukraine has set a quota for booking military personnel of enterprises of the military-industrial and fuel-energy complexes at the level of 95%. The decision was made on October 23, according to the website of the Cabinet.
